verdict.rationale: Agora's docs list its own real-time channel messaging and state synchronization capability, and pricing references a message allowance. That is a first-party data channel, but the evidence is a single thin mention. Nothing shows it carrying arbitrary data inside the same audio/video session, nor any latency figures or API reference. Missing for 10: evidence of arbitrary data exchange within the RTC audio/video session (e.g. a data-stream API), documented low-latency characteristics, API reference detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, participants exchange low-latency arbitrary data in the session alongside audio and video, with a documented data API

citations.quote: Channel messaging, presence, and real-time state synchronization.
